component.name: Caecilia.pl
component.summary: Editor for the abc notation format written with perl/pEFL

description.p: An Editor with Syntax Highlighting, MIDI recording, importing and playing functionality and a preview function with click-to-note (Left Mouseclick), insert-decorations-through Entry and Preview (left-click in Entry or longpress in Preview) and play-from-note (right click in Preview) feature for the ABC notation format (http://abcnotation.com/) written with perl/pEFL.
